correctness.rationale: Associativity uses total-degree preservation, right Ore uses coordinatewise common upper bounds, and integer inverse is −P^{−|a|}a. Positive word transformed-letter multiset gives complete adjacent-swap relations; their abelianization has one shared difference torsion generator killed by each cycle length. For central v, commutation with every generator implies (I−P)v=(I−P^{|v|})e_i, sum forces Pv=v and then P^{|v|}=I. Degree image of fixed lattice is gZ giving index m/g. Independent 153 permutation Smith checks match rank c and torsion g.
